## Estimate the number of effective outcome traits in the data

### Tree Cut

#### Correlation Structure Among all outcomes / variables

```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 8}
vars_2_test = colnames(mydata)[-c(1:7)]
# length(vars_2_test) ## 39

Cmat = mydata |> select(all_of(vars_2_test)) |> cor( use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "sp")
Dmat = as.dist( 1-abs(Cmat) )
nj = hclust(Dmat, method = "complete")

## k clusters based on cut height
k = cutree(nj, h = 0.5)
effnumb = length(unique(k)) ## 10


## Define Plot colors
pcol = c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Set1"), "black")

## Make a dendrogram
nj <- suppressWarnings( as.dendrogram(nj) |>
  set("labels_cex", 1.25) |> 
  color_branches( h = 0.5, col = pcol) |>
  color_labels(h = 0.5, col = pcol) 
)

## report k
cli::cli_alert_info( "Number of effective outcome traits based on tree cutting: {effnumb}" )
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
## Save dendrogram to file
f = "../results/figures/variable_correlation_dendrogram.pdf"
pdf(f, width = 15, height = 8)
par(mar = c(17,3,2,1) )
plot(nj, 
     main = paste0("Clustering of Variables Based on Spearman's Correlation Structure; k = ",effnumb) )
abline(h = 0.5, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
dev.off()
```


#### plot dendrogram

```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 8}

## plot dendrogram

```

### PCA

```{r}
pca_data = mydata |> select( all_of(vars_2_test) ) |> na.omit()
ind_pca_fit  = prcomp( pca_data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
var_pca_fit  = prcomp( Cmat, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
## extract variance explained
varexp = summary(var_pca_fit)[[6]][2,]
## extract cummulative variance explained
cum_varexp = summary(var_pca_fit)[[6]][3,]
## Cummulative number of PCs needed to explain >=95% of the variance
effnumb = min( which( cum_varexp > 0.95 ) )

cli::cli_alert_info( "Number of effective outcome traits based on PCA: {effnumb}" )
```

#### PCA plot of variable structure

```{r}
pcaplot = var_pca_fit$x |> as_tibble() |> mutate(k = as.factor(k) ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = k), size = 4, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = rownames(var_pca_fit$x), color = k), vjust = -1.2, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Plot of Variable Structure",
       x = paste0("Principal Component 1 ", " (", round(varexp[1]*100,1), "% Variance Explained)"),
       y = paste0("Principal Component 2 ", " (", round(varexp[2]*100,1), "% Variance Explained)"),
       fill = "Cluster",
       subtitle = "   - clusters defined by tree cut above") + 
  guides(color = "none")
  
## save pca plot to file

pdf(f, width = 8, height = 6)
print(pcaplot)
```

#### PCA biplot  of individual structure

```{r}
varexp = summary(ind_pca_fit)[[6]][2,]

## 1. Scores (for individuals)
scores <- ind_pca_fit$x[, 1:2] |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "Sample") |>
  select(1:3) 

## k-means on individuals given PC1 and PC2
ind_k = kmeans( scores[, 2:3], centers = 4)$cluster
scores <- scores |> mutate( k = as.factor(ind_k) )

## 2. Loadings (variables)
loadings <- ind_pca_fit$rotation[, 1:2] |>
  as_tibble(rownames = "Variable")

## 3. Select top 5 contributors for each PC (by absolute loading)
top_pc1 <- loadings |>
  arrange(desc(abs(PC1))) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

top_pc2 <- loadings |>
  arrange(desc(abs(PC2))) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)

# combine, allowing overlap but dropping duplicate rows
top_loadings <- bind_rows(top_pc1, top_pc2) |>
  distinct(Variable, .keep_all = TRUE)

## 4. Scale arrows to fit nicely in score space
arrow_mult <- min(
  (max(scores$PC1) - min(scores$PC1)) / (max(loadings$PC1) - min(loadings$PC1)),
  (max(scores$PC2) - min(scores$PC2)) / (max(loadings$PC2) - min(loadings$PC2))
)

top_loadings_scaled <- top_loadings |>
  mutate(
    PC1 = PC1 * arrow_mult * 0.8,
    PC2 = PC2 * arrow_mult * 0.8
  )

## 5. Plot: scores + only top loading arrows
biplot = ggplot() +
  # points (individuals)
  geom_point(
    data = scores,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = k),
    size = 4,
    alpha = 0.8,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  # loading arrows for top features
  geom_segment(
    data = top_loadings_scaled,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.02, "npc")),
    color = "dodgerblue"
  ) +
  # labels for top features
  geom_text(
    data = top_loadings_scaled,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Variable),
    hjust = 0.5,
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA Biplot",
    subtitle = "   - Top contributing variables shown",
    x = paste0("PC1 (Variance Explained = ", round(varexp[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (Variance Explained = ", round(varexp[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
    fill = "k-means\nCluster"
  )

```

### An extended analysis with sandwich estimators

```{r}
## Rank normal transformation
rnt <- function(x) {
  r <- rank(x, na.last = "keep")
  qnorm((r - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)))
}

## One model per outcome x transform
fit_condition <- function(y, transform = c("none", "scale", "rnt"), data = mydata) {
  transform <- match.arg(transform)
  lhs <- switch(transform,
    none  = paste0("`", y, "`"),
    scale = paste0("scale(`", y, "`)"),
    rnt   = paste0("rnt(`", y, "`)")
  )
  fit <- lmer(as.formula(paste(lhs, "~ Condition + (1|SubjectID)")), data = data)

  shap <- shapiro.test(residuals(fit))

  # CR2 sandwich SEs; for lmer fits the cluster defaults to the grouping factor
  # (SubjectID), so rows dropped for NA stay aligned
  rob <- as.data.frame(coef_test(fit, vcov = "CR2", test = "Satterthwaite"))
  rob <- rob[rob$Coef == "ConditionEX", ]

  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed") |>
    filter(term == "ConditionEX") |>
    mutate(outcome = y, .before = 1) |>
    mutate(
      shapiro_w        = unname(shap$statistic),
      shapiro_p        = shap$p.value,
      singular         = isSingular(fit),
      robust_std.error = rob$SE,
      robust_statistic = rob$tstat,
      robust_df        = rob$df_Satt,
      robust_p.value   = rob$p_Satt,
      .after = p.value
    )
}

## Descriptives by condition (original units)
cond_desc <- map_dfr(vars_2_test, \(y) {
  d <- mydata |>
    select(SubjectID, Condition, val = all_of(y)) |>
    filter(!is.na(val)) |>
    mutate(cond = if_else(Condition == "EX", "ex", "rest"))

  d |>
    group_by(cond) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(val), sd = sd(val), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = cond,
      values_from = c(n, mean, sd),
      names_glue  = "{.value}_{cond}"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      outcome  = y,
      n_pairs  = sum(table(d$SubjectID) == 2),
      sd_ratio = sd_ex / sd_rest,
      .before = 1
    ) |>
    relocate(n_rest, n_ex, mean_rest, sd_rest, mean_ex, sd_ex, sd_ratio, .after = n_pairs)
})

## Run all three versions
key <- c("outcome", "effect", "term")

orig_cond_effects <- map_dfr(vars_2_test, fit_condition, transform = "none")

scaled_cond_effects <- map_dfr(vars_2_test, fit_condition, transform = "scale") |>
  rename_with(\(x) paste0("scaled_", x), -all_of(key))

rnt_cond_effects <- map_dfr(vars_2_test, fit_condition, transform = "rnt") |>
  rename_with(\(x) paste0("rnt_", x), -all_of(key))

## Merge
cond_effects <- orig_cond_effects |>
  left_join(cond_desc, by = "outcome") |>
  relocate(names(cond_desc)[-1], .after = term) |>
  left_join(scaled_cond_effects, by = key) |>
  left_join(rnt_cond_effects, by = key) |>
  mutate(bh_padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"), .before = shapiro_w) |>
  mutate(meets_study_alpha = ifelse(p.value < 0.05 / 10, "yes", "no"), .before = shapiro_w) |>
  arrange(bh_padj)
```

## Carbohydrate oxidation and EI

### A repeated measure correlation

```{r}
d <- mydata |>
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, Condition,
                cho_ox = `Visit_CarbEE_(kcal)`,
                ei     = `Visit_Total_EI_(kcal)`) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cho_ox), !is.na(ei)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(SubjectID) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cho_between = mean(cho_ox),
                cho_within  = cho_ox - cho_between) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

## Repeated-measures correlation: within-person association only
rmc <- rmcorr(participant = SubjectID, measure1 = cho_ox, measure2 = ei, dataset = d)
rmc   # r, df, p, 95% CI

```

## A correlation of change

```{r}
dd <- d |>
  dplyr::select(SubjectID, Condition, cho_ox, ei) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = c(cho_ox, ei)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(d_cho = cho_ox_EX - cho_ox_CON, d_ei = ei_EX - ei_CON)

cor.test(dd$d_cho, dd$d_ei)   # association of individual changes, mean shift removed
```


### LMM separating within- and between-person associations

```{r}
fit <- lmer(ei ~ cho_within + cho_between + Condition + (1 | SubjectID), data = d)
summary(fit)
```


```{r}
ox_vars   <- c(cho_ox = "Visit_CarbEE_(kcal)", fat_ox = "Visit_FatEE_(kcal)")
resp_vars <- c(ei = "Visit_Total_EI_(kcal)",
               hunger = "Visit_VAS_Hunger_AUC", fullness = "Visit_VAS_Fullness_AUC",
               desire = "Visit_VAS_Desire_AUC", amount = "Visit_VAS_Amount_AUC",
               satisfied = "Visit_VAS_Satisfied_AUC")

## 1. Within-between models: oxidation vs EI and appetite
wb_fit <- function(x, y) {
  d <- mydata |>
    select(SubjectID, Condition, x = all_of(x), y = all_of(y)) |>
    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y)) |>
    group_by(SubjectID) |>
    mutate(x_between = mean(x), x_within = x - x_between) |>
    ungroup()
  fit <- lmer(y ~ x_within + x_between + Condition + (1 | SubjectID), data = d)
  broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(term %in% c("x_within", "x_between")) |>
    mutate(predictor = x, outcome = y, n_obs = nrow(d), .before = 1)
}

assoc_wb <- tidyr::expand_grid(x = ox_vars, y = resp_vars) |>
  pmap_dfr(\(x, y) wb_fit(x, y))

## 2. Exercise RER (EX visit only, one value per girl) vs EI and appetite
ex <- mydata |> filter(Condition == "EX")
assoc_rer <- map_dfr(resp_vars, \(y) {
  ct <- cor.test(ex$EX_REST_RQ, ex[[y]])
  tibble(predictor = "EX_REST_RQ", outcome = y, n = sum(complete.cases(ex$EX_REST_RQ, ex[[y]])),
         r = unname(ct$estimate), conf.low = ct$conf.int[1], conf.high = ct$conf.int[2],
         p.value = ct$p.value)
})

assoc_rer |> knitr::kable() |> kableExtra::kable_classic()
```


## Table 2 

```{r}
table2_vars <- c("Visit_Total_EI_(kcal)", "Visit_FAT_Intake_(kcal)", "Visit_CHO_Intake_(kcal)",
                 "Visit_Protien_Intake_(kcal)", "Visit_24HourEE_(kcal)", "Activity_EE",
                 "Visit_nonActivity24HourEE_(kcal)", "Visit_Total_EB_(kcal)", "Visit_Fat_EB_(kcal)",
                 "Visit_CHO_EB_(kcal)", "Visit_Protien_EB_(kcal)", "Visit_24HourRQ", "EX_REST_RQ",
                 "Visit_FatEE_(kcal)", "Visit_CarbEE_(kcal)", "Visit_ProtienEE_(kcal)")

table2 <- map_dfr(table2_vars, \(y) {
  fit <- lmer(as.formula(paste0("`", y, "` ~ Condition + (1|SubjectID)")), data = mydata)
  # em  <- summary(emmeans(fit, ~ Condition))
  # ct  <- summary(contrast(emmeans(fit, ~ Condition), "revpairwise"))
  em_obj <- emmeans(fit, ~ Condition, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
  em  <- summary(em_obj)
  ct  <- summary(contrast(em_obj, "revpairwise"))
  tibble(outcome  = y,
         ex_mean  = em$emmean[em$Condition == "EX"],  ex_se  = em$SE[em$Condition == "EX"],
         rest_mean = em$emmean[em$Condition == "CON"], rest_se = em$SE[em$Condition == "CON"],
         diff = ct$estimate, p.value = ct$p.value)
})
```

```{r}
## Formatting helpers
fmt_num <- function(x, d) formatC(round(x, d), format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = " ")

sup <- function(s) chartr("-0123456789", "\u207b\u2070\u00b9\u00b2\u00b3\u2074\u2075\u2076\u2077\u2078\u2079", s)

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  out <- formatC(p, format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#")
  small <- p < 0.001
  e <- floor(log10(p[small]))
  m <- round(p[small] / 10^e, 1)
  e[m == 10] <- e[m == 10] + 1
  m[m == 10] <- 1
  out[small] <- paste0(formatC(m, format = "f", digits = 1), " \u00d7 10", sup(e))
  out
}

## Build display table
t2_df <- lab |>
  left_join(table2, by = "outcome") |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    ex   = paste0(fmt_num(ex_mean, digits),   " \u00b1 ", fmt_num(ex_se, digits)),
    rest = paste0(fmt_num(rest_mean, digits), " \u00b1 ", fmt_num(rest_se, digits)),
    dif  = fmt_num(diff, digits),
    p    = fmt_p(p.value)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(group, label, ex, rest, dif, p)

t2 <- gt(t2_df, groupname_col = "group", rowname_col = "label") |>
  # tab_header(title = md("**Table 2:** Energy balance and substrate utilization between conditions")) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "EX",                     columns = ex) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "REST",                   columns = rest) |>
  tab_spanner(label = "Difference (EX \u2212 REST)", columns = dif) |>
  cols_label(ex = "Mean \u00b1 SE", rest = "Mean \u00b1 SE", dif = "Mean", p = md("*p* value")) |>
  cols_align("center", columns = c(ex, rest, dif, p)) |>
  tab_stub_indent(rows = everything(), indent = 3) |>
  tab_source_note(paste(
    "Values are model-estimated means \u00b1 SE from linear mixed models with condition as a fixed effect",
    "and a random intercept for participant; differences are model-estimated EX \u2212 REST.",
    "p values are from t tests with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom. All available observations were",
    "included; one participant was missing REST data for chamber-derived outcomes.",
    "Abbreviations: EX, exercise condition; REST, rest condition; EI, energy intake;",
    "EE, energy expenditure; EB, energy balance; RER, respiratory exchange ratio."
  )) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.names         = "Times New Roman",
    heading.align            = "left",
    row_group.font.weight    = "bold",
    column_labels.font.weight = "normal",
    table.border.top.color   = "black",
```

## Figure 2

```{r, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 8}
##  Inputs
paired <- FALSE   # TRUE draws a light line joining each girl's REST and EX values
alpha  <- 0.005

meal_vars <- expand_grid(meal = c("Breakfast", "Lunch", "Snack", "Diner"),
                         nutr = c("total", "PRO", "Fat", "CHO")) |>
  mutate(var = paste0(meal, "_", nutr, "_(kcal)"))

### Long data with manual dodge + jitter 
set.seed(2026)
plot_df <- mydata |>
  select(SubjectID, Condition, all_of(meal_vars$var)) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(SubjectID, Condition), names_to = "var", values_to = "kcal") |>
  filter(!is.na(kcal)) |>
  left_join(meal_vars, by = "var") |>
  mutate(
    meal      = factor(if_else(meal == "Diner", "Dinner", meal),
                       levels = c("Breakfast", "Lunch", "Snack", "Dinner")),
    Condition = factor(if_else(Condition == "EX", "EX", "REST"), levels = c("REST", "EX")),
    x         = as.numeric(meal) + if_else(Condition == "EX", 0.18, -0.18),
    x_j       = x + runif(n(), -0.07, 0.07)
  )

means_df <- plot_df |>
  group_by(nutr, meal, Condition, x) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(kcal), .groups = "drop")

### p value labels (plotmath, exact values)
p_lab <- function(p) {
  if (p >= 0.001) return(sprintf('italic(p) == "%s"', formatC(p, format = "fg", digits = 2, flag = "#")))
  e <- floor(log10(p)); m <- round(p / 10^e, 1)
  if (m == 10) { m <- 1; e <- e + 1 }
  sprintf('italic(p) == "%s" %%*%% 10^%d', formatC(m, format = "f", digits = 1), e)
}

panel_max <- plot_df |> group_by(nutr) |> summarise(pmax = max(kcal))
meal_max  <- plot_df |> group_by(nutr, meal) |> summarise(top = max(kcal), .groups = "drop")

## narrower jitter, slightly wider separation between conditions
plot_df <- plot_df |>
  mutate(x   = as.numeric(meal) + if_else(Condition == "EX", 0.2, -0.2),
         x_j = x + runif(n(), -0.05, 0.05))
means_df <- plot_df |>
  group_by(nutr, meal, Condition, x) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(kcal), .groups = "drop")

plot_nutr <- function(n, title) {
  d  <- filter(plot_df,  nutr == n)
  m  <- filter(means_df, nutr == n)
  pa <- filter(p_df,     nutr == n)

  ggplot() +
    (if (paired) geom_line(data = d, aes(x_j, kcal, group = interaction(SubjectID, meal)),
                           colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3)) +
    geom_point(data = d, aes(x_j, kcal, shape = Condition, fill = Condition),
               size = 2.6, stroke = 0.5, colour = "grey25", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(data = m, aes(x = x - 0.16, xend = x + 0.16, y = mean, yend = mean),
                 linewidth = 1.4, lineend = "butt") +
    geom_segment(data = pa, aes(x = xc - 0.2, xend = xc + 0.2, y = yb, yend = yb)) +
    geom_segment(data = pa, aes(x = xc - 0.2, xend = xc - 0.2, y = yb, yend = yb - tick)) +
    geom_segment(data = pa, aes(x = xc + 0.2, xend = xc + 0.2, y = yb, yend = yb - tick)) +
    geom_text(data = pa, aes(x = xc, y = yb + tick, label = label),
              parse = TRUE, vjust = 0, size = 3.3) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(REST = 21, EX = 24), name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c(REST = "grey45", EX = "grey90"), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:4, labels = levels(plot_df$meal),
                       expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Intake (kcal)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          axis.text   = element_text(colour = "black"))
}

###  Patchwork 
fig2 <- (plot_nutr("total", "Total energy") + plot_nutr("PRO", "Protein")) /
        (plot_nutr("Fat",   "Fat")          + plot_nutr("CHO", "Carbohydrate")) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))

fig2
```

## Modeling Energy Intake across meals

### extract meal data 

```{r}
meal_data = mydata |>
  select(SubjectID, Condition, contains( c("Breakfast", "Lunch","Snack", "Diner") )) 
```

### pivot meal data long

```{r}
meal_data <- meal_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(SubjectID, Condition),
    names_to = c("Meal", "Nutrient"),
    values_to = "EI",
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(.*)_\\(kcal\\)$"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Meal = case_when(
      Meal == "Diner" ~ "Dinner",   # fix typo if you want
      TRUE ~ Meal
    ),
    Meal = tolower(Meal),
    Nutrient = tolower(Nutrient)
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Nutrient,
    values_from = EI
  )

```

### edit meal data nomenclature

```{r}
## redfine condition
meal_data <- meal_data |>
  mutate(
    Condition = case_when(
      Condition == "CON"     ~ "rest",
      Condition == "EX" ~ "exercise",
      TRUE ~ Condition
    )
  )

```

### Testing for a meal condition interaction

```{r}
## define the outcome to run
outcomes = colnames(meal_data)[-c(1:3)]

## run the tests
meal_test_results = lapply(outcomes, function(y) {
  test_meal_condition_interaction(meal_data, outcome = y)
})

## set names
names(meal_test_results) = outcomes

```

### Is there evidence of an interaction effect?

```{r}
## extract interaction p-values
lapply(meal_test_results, function(x) x$interaction_pvalue) |> unlist()
```


### meal specific effects

```{r}

meal_effects = lapply(meal_test_results, function(x) x$emm_out) |> 
  bind_rows() |> 
  mutate( bh_padj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH") )

## write summary stats to file
f = "../../results/tables/meal_specific_Estimate_Marginal_Mean_effect_summary_statistics.csv"
write.csv(meal_effects, f, row.names = FALSE)


meal_effects |>
```

## Contrasting choice of LMM frameworks to identify an effect of condition on Dinner Fat

### Fit a LMM for Dinner Fat ~ Condition + (1|SubjectID)

```{r}
fit  <- lmer( `Diner_Fat_(kcal)` ~ Condition + (1|SubjectID), data = mydata)

cli::cli_alert_info( "Summary of LMM fit for Dinner Fat ~ Condition + (1|SubjectID)" )
summary(fit)$coef

cat(paste0("\n\n"))

cli::cli_alert_info( "Estimated Marginal Means and Pairwise Contrasts for Condition Effect on Dinner Fat" )
emmeans(fit, "Condition", contr = "pairwise")

## is the p-value the same as above?
# as.data.frame(emmeans(fit, "Condition", contr = "pairwise")$contrast )[,6] ## Yes !!
```

### Fit a LMM with Meal and Condition interaction for Fat intake

```{r}
fit1 = lmer( fat ~ Condition * Meal + (1 | SubjectID), data = meal_data)
summary(fit1)$coef
```

#### extract emmeans and contrasts for Dinner Fat

```{r}
## estimate the marginal means and contrasts for Dinner Fat
emm = emmeans(fit1, ~ Condition | Meal, contr = "pairwise") 

cli::cli_alert_info( "Estimated Marginal Means for Condition Effect on Dinner Fat from Meal LMM" )
emm$emmeans[3:4]
  
cli::cli_alert_info( "Pairwise Contrasts for Condition Effect on Dinner Fat from Meal LMM" )
emm$contrasts[2]

```
